2025-08-14

VCF filtering - Figure 2a,b

In previous version, we have:

“In total, 10,041 variants, with an allele frequency (AF) higher than 0.05, were identified at 6,097 different positions across all evolved populations (including the solvent-control conditions), with a median of 28 variants (Figures 2a; EV4a, b).”

According to our discussion last time (Simone, Sonja, Rui; 2025.08.06); we are filtering variants that were appeared in both control and xenobiotic groups; as those are highly likely to be pre-exist variants.

We have mentioned/discussed this in the past that variants we identified includes: 1) newly emerged mutations 2) pre-exist genetic variants emerged / sequenced due to increased ratio in population

One reason we have the above 2) is our parental strain was not single colony.

Now, with new filtering:

  1. Ref + Alt depth >= 20;
  2. Alt depth >= 5; this filtered out the most of the variants
  3. Positions with prevalence < 24 (i.e. max. appeared in 3 diff. xenobiotics) this will be refined

After filtering, 868 variants in 422 positions were remained. As we can see, most of them appeared in one sample.

We here print out the positions with Prevalence > 10.
